Grand Slam of Darts: Gerwyn Price produces controversial 145 checkout en route to routine victory over Sebastian Bialecki
Fourth seed Gerwyn Price hits controversial checkout in 5-2 win against Poland's Sebastian Bialecki; you can watch the Grand Slam of Darts in Wolverhampton live on Sky Sports up until the final on November 22
Monday 16 November 2026 22:29, UK
Gerwyn Price produced a controversial 145 checkout en route to a routine Grand Slam of Darts victory over Sebastian Bialecki on Monday night in Wolverhampton.
Both players went into the contest with one win each after beating Joe Hunt, which made it a straight shoot-out with only the group winners reaching the knockout stage this year.
Price had opened his week with a 5-3 win over Hunt on Saturday, racing into a 4-0 lead before Hunt won three legs in a row. Bialecki needed a deciding leg to beat Hunt 5-4 on Sunday.

Price, the three-time champion in Wolverhampton came through 5-2 against Poland's Bialecki to book his place in the knockout stage.
However, there was controversy during the final Group E match as Price hit a 145 finish when he had 135 remaining in the fourth leg of the match.
'The Iceman' needed 135 to hold his throw, and he thought he had taken it out.
After hitting T19 he asked referee Charlie Corstophine what he had left and was told 88.
However, he actually needed 78.
With 88 in mind, Price incorrectly hit T16 and D20 to finish off the leg and was given the hold.
Of course, Price believed he had gone the correct route for what he needed and went on to set up a last 16 date with Ryan Searle.
"I didn't know until I just walked in," said Price in his press conference. "I hit the first treble and I asked what I'd got left and he said 88.
"So I went treble 16 double top and he said game shot. I swear to god I didn't know until I came back here!"
What does the PDC rulebook say?
6.4.6 Errors in arithmetic shall stand as detailed on the scoreboard unless corrected prior to the next throw of the player whose score is in error. Any error in the score can be corrected by the Referee at any time until Game Shot is called in
that leg.
6.4.7 If the incorrect score resulted in a leg win the result will stand unless corrected prior to the start of the next leg.

digest_he:
שחקן הדרטס המדורג רביעי, גרבין פרייס, רשם ניצחון שגרתי בתוצאה 5-2 על סבסטיאן ביאבצקי מפולין במסגרת שלב הבתים של טורניר גרנד סלאם הדרטס שמתקיים בוולברההמפטון, ובכך הבטיח את מקומו בשלב הנוקאאוט. למרות הניצחון, המשחק לוהט במחלוקת סביב זריקה בשלב הרקע של המערכה הרביעית, כאשר פרייס ביצע צ'ק-אאוט של 145 למרות שנותרו לו 135 נקודות בלבד לסגירה.

פרייס ניגש לזרוק כדי לשמור על ההגשה שלו וכיוון ל-135. לאחר שקלע טריפל 19, שאל פרייס את השופט כמה נותר לו וקיבל תשובה שגויה של 88 נקודות, בעוד שבפועל נדרשו לו 78 נקודות בלבד. כתוצאה מכך, הוא זרק לטריפל 16 ולדאבל 20 והשופט אישר את סיום הלג כחוק. על פי ספר החוקים הרשמי של ארגון ה-PDC, טעויות חשבוניות מצד השופט נותרות על כנן אלא אם תוקנו טרם זריקתו הבאה של השחקן או קודם קריאת סיום הלג.
